title: Deep-learning tissue regions link stromal features to bladder cancer chemoresistance
summary: Three CNN models classified tumor, necrosis and lymphocyte regions on H&E slides; patches negative for all were termed AI-defined Other regions. Higher Other% was associated with shorter survival in univariable analysis but not after multivariable adjustment in TCGA. Among 48 specimens in an ex vivo drug-sensitivity test, Other% was higher in the gemcitabine-cisplatin-resistant group, and multiplex immunofluorescence showed enriched alpha-SMA signal in these regions.
ai_technology: Three convolutional neural networks classifying histology regions, with residual Other% quantification
organization: Nanchang University; Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University; Second Hospital of Nanchang

evidence.tested: Independent tissue microarray for the classifiers; ex vivo test on 48 specimens.
evidence.unknown: Association only; Other not trained as a fibroblast classifier; no multivariable survival significance; full text not reviewed.
